paragraphs: I am applying for the Senior Manager, Platform Software Engineering position at Oracle. I build product experiences that turn complex, manual workflows into practical tools, combining engineering, interface design and AI-assisted development, and I would like to bring that focus to your team.

At Hypeo, a MENA creator-marketing SaaS platform, I delivered a contextual AI chat that turns open-ended client conversations into configured marketing campaigns, connected to the internal influencer database. I built and refined the front-end experience in close collaboration with a senior technical lead, adapting the workflows as backend integration and business requirements evolved.

Earlier, at Cyber Cohesion, I led web development of a CTF platform used at events such as OWASP AppSec Days and BSides Singapore, including a Go API service that orchestrated isolated application deployments. At Cogy Tech, I brought 02Book, an AI-powered writing assistant for B2B writers, to production and helped roll out a standardized delivery process across the team.
Thank you for your time and consideration. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how I could contribute to the work at Oracle.
